messages:
julia.kim: FYI found a suspicious entry in CI artifact for payments: `deploy.log.gz` contains a `vault:` blob and plaintext service account email. saving artifact to secure bucket for forensics.
omar.zhao: thanks, snapshot first then we triage. can you paste the artifact path?
julia.kim: gs://artifacts-payments/ci/4812/deploy.log.gz. snippet: `vault:v1:AAABBBccc...==` and `serviceAccount: payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
ops-bot: Incident-Alert: possible secret exposure in CI (channel: #eng-security). Ticket created: SEC-INC-2027-101.
nicole_park: immediate plan: 1) snapshot artifact (done), 2) search last 14 days of CI artifacts for similar patterns, 3) restrict SA permissions and schedule key rotation if a key id is present.
security-oncall: severity P2. preserve all logs; legal looped in for retention guidance. do not delete original artifact.
omar.zhao: quick triage: that `vault:` prefix suggests either transit ciphertext or a wrapped response token. transit ciphertext is safer unless transit key is compromised. we need to identify which.
julia.kim: grep over CI artifacts returned 9 matches in last 10 days. uploaded a checksum list to ticket.
infra-automation: runbook step: do not paste tokens. use vault admin host to run token lookups. also spin up a staging rewrap to validate process.
nicole_park: suggested GCP audit queries: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --freshness=30d'` and build logs search: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="build" AND textPayload:vault' --project=redwood-ci --freshness=14d'`. please attach outputs.
omar.zhao: mitigation: temporarily remove `roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` from payments SA and add viewer-only role until we confirm. i'll execute and post commands to the ticket.
security-oncall: also enable Vault audit (file backend) if not already and export logs to secure bucket. capture CI provider logs before any rotation.
julia.kim: found an entry referencing `transit:ingest-key` in one artifact; transit key shows no anomalous usage in the last 30d. still, plan: rotate the SA keys and rewrap any Vault KV entries that reference the old key id.
infra-automation: will run a dry-run bulk rewrap in staging for a small set. OPS ticket OPS-909 created for automation.
nicole_park: rotation steps: create new SA key, upload to Vault at `secret/ci/payment-service/key`, update CI to use new TTL-limited key, then revoke old key. document everything in SEC-INC-2027-101.
omar.zhao: starting permission revoke now: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` and add viewer role. posting confirmation.
ops-bot: SEC-INC-2027-101 updated: tasks assigned (snapshot-artifact, search-artifacts, revoke-keys, dump-audit-logs).
julia.kim: please add CI linter to fail builds when PEM-like blocks or `vault:` prefixes appear in artifacts; that would have prevented leakage.
infra-automation: will prototype a linter rule and run in canary for two weeks. creating TECHDEBT ticket TD-777.
security-oncall: ensure partner teams and any downstream consumers of artifacts rotate cached credentials if they pulled artifacts. template partner notice drafted in ticket.
nicole_park: rotated SA key and uploaded new key to Vault with `ttl=6h` for CI job rollout. will revoke old key after smoke tests pass.
omar.zhao: old key revoked; posted revocation timestamp and audit export.
julia.kim: finished artifact search; uploaded list and checksums. follow-ups: SECURITY-507 (logging/Sentry scrubbing), OPS-909 (vault rewrap automation), IAM-312 (workload-identity migration).
security-oncall: good work. prepare a short incident summary for the next security sync. SEC-INC-2027-101 will stay open until CI linter and workload-identity plan are in progress.
ops-bot: SEC-INC-2027-101 status changed to Monitoring; assignees: julia.kim, omar.zhao, nicole_park.
